async def act(page):
    # Click the Search button to apply the status filter (already set to Approved)
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Extract the total records count text from the specific cell
    total_cell = page.get_by_role('cell').filter(has_text='Total')
    total_text = await total_cell.inner_text()
    # Parse the number from the text (e.g., 'Total 24 records found')
    import re
    match = re.search(r'\d+', total_text)
    if match:
        count = match.group()
    else:
        count = '0'  # Default if no number found
    # Print the count so it can be captured as output
    print(count)
